verificationMethod: Independent checks of current airport/operator passenger contact and map pages before any new live SerpApi run; application output was not used as truth.

sources.title: Changi Airport Contact Information
sources.evidence: Official passenger contact page says to call +65 6595 6868 to speak to a Changi Experience Ambassador.

sources.title: Changi Airport Map: All Terminals & Jewel
sources.evidence: Official interactive passenger map lets users select and zoom airport terminals and Jewel.

ICN.phoneRole: Incheon International Airport Customer Service/help desk

sources.title: Emergency Contacts | Incheon International Airport
sources.evidence: Official airport help-desk table gives 1577-2600 and 82-2-1577-2600 for international use, 07:00–22:00.

sources.title: Incheon International Airport Map
sources.evidence: The official Airport Map navigation opens the airport.kr interactive geomap with terminal query parameters.

HEL.phoneRole: Helsinki Airport Information & Parking/general airport matters; Finavia exchange is acceptable switchboard fallback

sources.title: Helsinki Airport's information and parking
sources.evidence: Official Finavia customer-service page gives +358 200 14636 for 24-hour airport information and parking service.

sources.title: Contact details of Finavia Corporation
sources.evidence: Official operator page gives the Finavia exchange +358 20 708 000.

sources.title: Helsinki Airport map
sources.evidence: Official page opens the interactive terminal layout and service-location map.

FCO.phoneRole: ADR airport operator and flight-information call center

sources.title: Useful numbers | ADR
sources.evidence: Official airport operator page lists 06 6595 1 for the airport operator and flight information, 24 hours.

sources.title: Rome Fiumicino Airport Maps | ADR
sources.evidence: Official passenger map entry covers Fiumicino terminals, floors, boarding areas and pedestrian routes.

SYD.phoneRole: Sydney Airport general enquiries and feedback

sources.title: Contact Us | Sydney Airport
sources.evidence: Current official contact page's primary call block gives 133 SYD domestically and +61 2 9667 9111 outside Australia; a legacy error message/FAQ still exposes +61 2 9667 6111, recorded as an observed official discrepancy.

sources.title: Sydney Airport Maps
sources.evidence: Official page lists downloadable T1, T2 and T3 terminal maps and links the airport's interactive map.

GRU.phoneRole: Passenger Customer Assistance Center; GRU Airport Information switchboard is acceptable

sources.title: Contact Us | GRU Airport
sources.evidence: Official page lists the Passenger Terminal Customer Assistance Center at +55 11 2445-2252 and GRU Airport Information at +55 11 2445-2945, both 24/7.

sources.title: Mapa do Aeroporto | GRU Airport
sources.evidence: Official passenger page shows airport terminal layout and airline placement for Terminals 1, 2 and 3.

sources.title: iGA customer care
sources.evidence: Current official iGA material labels 444 1 442 as the customer-care number; official iGA web properties repeat the same number.

sources.title: Official passenger map not independently resolved
sources.evidence: The current official passenger site could not be independently fetched to a stable map URL during golden verification, so only the exact Google Maps IST airport location is an allowed map degradation.
